title: Compulsory acquisitions and buyouts
subject: This guide addresses compulsory acquisitions and buyout rights under Chapter 6A of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth). It explains the purposes of these provisions, ASIC's administration, exemptions and modifications, and the process for nominating experts to prepare reports under s667AA.
background: Chapter 6A of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) provides the legislative framework for compulsory acquisitions and buyout rights in corporate takeovers. ASIC administers these provisions and has powers to grant exemptions and modifications, as well as to nominate experts for independent reports.
ruling: ASIC outlines the principles underlying post-bid and general compulsory acquisitions, including the 90% relevant interest threshold and the 75% acquisition threshold. The guide explains requirements for bidding for all securities, treatment of employee and non-transferable securities, and the six-month time limit for general compulsory acquisitions. ASIC also provides guidance on when it will consider case-by-case relief and the process for applying for exemptions or modifications.
